templates.why_chosen: Two rows sharing one horizontal time axis, with a green 'Minimized Downtime' annotation on the gap being compared.
templates.what_to_learn: Two stacked timelines on one shared axis make a duration claim readable at a glance; keep role colours (stayer/leaver/joiner) identical across rows.

templates.why_chosen: The reference doc's own cross-reference for phase-lanes: TrainMover's row and the baseline row sit column-aligned under one shared Training Timeline arrow, so the bottom row's longer gap visually proves the downtime claim without a number.
templates.what_to_learn: Put one shared time arrow directly under two stacked system rows drawn to the same horizontal scale, keep matching phases (preparation, switching) column-aligned between them, and let the visual length of the gap, not a caption number, carry the downtime comparison; color-code recurring machine roles (stayer, leaver, joiner) consistently in both rows.
